card.name: Right before hydration or fluids
card.fires_on: The word or word start just before "hydration", "hydrated" or "fluids", such as "adequate", "re" in "rehydrated", or "HY" in capitals. It appears in warnings about kidney function or tumor lysis syndrome.

modes.label: Adequate before hydration
modes.description: The word "adequate" or "maintaining" comes right before hydration or fluids.
modes.example: Due to potential for TLS, maintain<< adequate>> hydration

modes.label: Start of rehydrated
modes.description: The "re" or "HY" piece that begins a hydration word that is split up.
modes.example: Patients should be adequately<< re>>hydrated prior to administration of zoled

card.writes: It pushes the model to write fluid, hydration and hydrate words next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that the patient needs enough fluids or hydration.
